relationships.subject: ammonia

relationships.subject: lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: The smallest hemolytic areas were obtained after incubation with 10% lidocaine in ethanol

relationships.subject: Symsitive
relationships.evidence_quote: Symsitive® is composed of trans-4-t-butylcyclohexanol, a TRPV1 receptor antagonist

key_findings: Ammonia, bleach, lemon juice, cola, sodium chloride and papain trigger P. noctiluca nematocyst discharge and are contraindicated as sting treatments.
Lidocaine, hydroxyacetophenone and Symsitive (TRPV1 antagonist) formulations inhibit nematocyst discharge and reduce venom hemolytic area; butylene glycol reduces discharge.
